SELECT pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) as count
FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions
WHERE collision_date LIKE '2021-%'
GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 5;

args.sql:
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2021-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_2021,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2021-%' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_2021,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2011-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_2011,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2011-%' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_2011
    FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions
)
SELECT 
    (speeding_2011 * 100.0 / total_2011) - (speeding_2021 * 100.0 / total_2021) as percentage_point_decrease
FROM counts;

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2021-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_2021,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2021-%' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_2021,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2011-%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_2011,
        SUM(CASE WHEN collision_date LIKE '2011-%' AND pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as speeding_2011
    FROM california_traffic_collision.main.collisions
)
SELECT 
    speeding_2011 * 100.0 / total_2011 as share_2011,
    speeding_2021 * 100.0 / total_2021 as share_2021
FROM counts;

SELECT pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) as count
